PANJAB UNIVERSITY CONSTITUENT COLLEGE
PATTO HIRA SINGH, NIHAL SIGH WALA (MOGA)
Interview for the post of Guest Faculty
Applications are invited for the post of Guest Faculty in Punjabi and Commerce at Panjab
UniversityConstituent College, Patto Hira Singh , Nihal Singh Wala(Moga) for the session
2022-2023
No. of Posts:– Punjabi-01 , Commerce-01
Qualification: As per Panjab University/UGC norms.
Salary (NET) Rs.25000/- per month .
Interested candidates may send their duly filled application form at
Email:pucc.nsw@gmail.com by 13/01/2023. Prescribed application from is given along
with this advertisement.
Date, Time & Venue will be intimated to the eligible candidates through the mail id
stated in their application form.
